references.label: Seven-target upper bank
references.description: Upper drop-target bank whose repeated full completions advance toward Special at the central red targets.

references.label: Four-target lower bank
references.description: Two colored target pairs that raise awards and light the red and blue bumpers.

references.label: Central multiplier targets
references.description: Targets that advance a moving value through points, 3x, 4x, 5x, and alternating outlane Special.

references.label: Captive-ball lane
references.description: Upper-left lane whose installed switches award Extra Ball when all are passed.

references.label: Kickout hole
references.description: Upper-left eject hole that advances its award and can light Special at the captive-ball lane.

references.label: Lower-right 100,000 lane
references.description: Lane that collects 100,000 after A-B-C-D-E-F is completed.
